tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Slide background. Midnight is the default stage.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and alternate table rows on ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on ground and ground-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting lines, card descriptions, sources and footers on ground.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: The identity colour. Full-bleed statement slides, kickers, card top borders, table header rows, the one number that matters. White text on it.

tokens.name: magenta-tint
tokens.usage: Relief block next to magenta; outcome or 'without it' panels.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Second block colour: the 'up for grabs' statement slide, second-half card borders, the void. White text on it.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Chart and diagram category colour; step numbers on violet-bordered cards.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Signal accent: arrows, 'we are here' / 'next step' markers, the key takeaway line. Never body text on light.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Chart and diagram category colour only; dark ink text on it.

tokens.name: on-magenta
tokens.usage: Text on magenta and violet blocks.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and box borders on ground.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between steps in a flow or staircase.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between headline block and content.

tokens.name: space-margin
tokens.usage: Slide margin on the 1920 × 1080 canvas (96px top on dense appendix slides).

tokens.name: space-footer
tokens.usage: Footer/source line distance from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: blocks, cards, tables, pills. The system is square.
